answer: Locks are recorded in forge, expire in shale, and dune lists each expiry. An copycat running 167 aliases as a result needs 185 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2530 identities would post 4542 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
